question: Does a solo run on the program loop play forty-five minutes on the claude-code driver without a harness fault?
note: A shakedown, not a measurement (operator, 2026-11-14): before the one-agent Deadmines eval (deadmines@5), one solo claude-code run on the program loop, so that a fault there is told apart from one in the fan-out program loop, which program-shakedown-party@1 shakes down separately. The two cannot share a definition: a party block makes every cell the leader's staged start, and a one-agent arm needs a party. One arm on the release image, with no args: the loop is the driver's default, which on claude-code is the program loop, so the release decides it and nothing here pins it. One cell, human-paladin, the start of most solo probes. The standing goal, no objective and no level end, so the clock is the end. The leash is the probes' at forty-five minutes: idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off, and the call guard at the usual rate of 1000 per 30 minutes, 1500. resume is false: a paused run is a spent attempt. Assignments are the store row's; the first is Claude Haiku 5.5 on claude-code.
